rule: one frozen file per strategy, written before its first bet, containing the signal, the thresholds, the universe and the exact settlement rule

D-S1.name: side of our own number where both estimators agree
D-S1.universe: every game on the official rolling slate for today .. today+2, all 30 clubs
D-S1.settlement_rule: settle only from an official final that the nba.com scoreboard and the game book agree on; a game whose printed quarter scores do not sum to its final is settled on the score alone and flagged; a game with no verified final stays unsettled
D-S1.note: frozen before any bet because no strategy is funded; editing this file changes its hash, and the hash is published in the ledger
